title: Our game is at the "Steam Next Fest" and people totally HATE it at first sight because of the AI art mix. But LOVE it when they Play it (We are a only a main Game Designer and Programmer)
author: Blackantonet
selftext:
We used a combination of Gemini and Midjourney for the vast majority of the assets and we added our profesional skills with Photoshop and Art editing to transform it and give it shape.  
Then we added our main skills in Game Design and Programming to make a game that has a little soul.

The only issue is that the people HATE it on first sight but everyone that tested and played it LOVE the idea and gameplay behind.

This little project experiment showed me that people are really frustrated with the flood of slop games. But showed me that we solo developers that we do not have time or resources have to adapt and survive. The next game will surely be made by me... But I totally expect the patience and care of the audience, as they will surely to resort that is an ugly game.

We also learnt a lot of Marketing and the production process for STEAM. And we reached our personal humble goal even, if we are going to get ripped by the audience. 😄

What do you think? Adapt and use AI even if the world hates you like us. Or lower the head and go the hard way without assistance and pray that the love your mediocre Art.

I personally think that the final goal is to reach someone that makes the art... But that is MONEY and also they use AI. Silly do not you think?

comments.author: slipstream0
comments.body: Personal feeling of ai usage aside, if the first images are clearly and distinctly AI it makes me lose all hope that the game isn’t slop. If you’re going to use it, at least modify it enough that it doesn’t scream “I copied this straight from ai”.

replies.author: Blackantonet
replies.body:
That is not from us. We spent days changing the prompts, modifing the results with Photoshop and givibg form to everything to be cohesive. 
This trailer is from 3 months ago and we have further updates the models and the Office ingame. 😁✨

replies.author: ffxivthrowaway03
replies.body:
The first thing I noticed was just how inconsistent the characters were.  The three men look like western comic book characters drawn by slightly different artists, and the woman is distinctly anime.

There's better workflows for creating consistent character style beyond yoloing prompts at midjourney and praying.  You should spend some time there and it'll go a long way towards breaking that "slop" first reaction.

replies.author: Blackantonet
replies.body: They are already changed in the final Game. 🤣

replies.author: ffxivthrowaway03
replies.body: Then releasing a demo with the old assets was a genuine bad call.  Should've pushed a newer build with the correct visuals.  Game marketing lives and dies by first impressions.

replies.author: [deleted]
replies.body: [deleted]

comments.body:
I feel like you brought the skills AI is most capable of covering then outsourced the part AI is least capable of doing to AI.  
    
The moment the blond guy started walking I was in tears! No wonder you got cooked. There are a lot of mistakes I think people won’t notice and plenty people will, the problem is AI art mistakes tend to be very jarring and the kind that become impossible to unsee once you see them.  
    
I think as far as AI generated art goes it’s definitely on the better side but unfortunately still feels like it doesn’t stick the landing, good luck though.

replies.author: Blackantonet
replies.body: We left Jeremy (The blond guy) to walk like this because is really funny in the Gameplay and testing. This is a trailer from 3 months ago, so you can expect that everything has been retouched since then and feels good. ☺️

comments.author: Substantial_Chest400
comments.body: If people truly love it then remove the AI artwork. The competition is so insanely high that potential customers will instantly dismiss games with AI art covers/trailers. There's no point wasting time on potential slopware when there's thousands of great handcrafted games out there.

replies.author: Blackantonet
replies.body:
You are an artist? Will you join us for free? We expect you to be somewhat really good that can be compared to me as main Game Designer and my partner as a Programmer. 

It is a little project and It is a good Game so we are good. The Next project is the serious one, as now we have experienced the profuction and marketing and reached our estimated goals in sone places.

replies.author: reverendblueball

comments.author: vurt72
comments.body:
Why make the most ultra generic AI graphics possible though, you are completely and utterly unlimited with AI in terms of style. And why not spend some time on the animation, it's unlimited as well. doing 2 frames for walking?  you can do life-like walking with almost no effort. A little generic, nothing wrong with that but...   
   
If people see;  
1. its made with AI  
2. no effort was spent, at all.

Why wouldnt it anger people? Use AI but use it in a way where people go "wtf, this looks awesome!" that's how we prove AI isn't the garbage everyone thinks it is.
